issues.description: Item 1: knuckle_rise moves a fixed-size ellipsoid outward instead of growing the knuckle. The knuckle centre is lifted by rise x N_head while its dorsal half-axis stays at 0.496 N_head. At the demo's 0.3 the index knuckle already reads as a round ball stuck on the metacarpal head, with a valley ring around its base in the +35 view, visible at 1x. At in-range values 0.6-1.0 it becomes a bead on a narrowing neck, and the silhouette gets worse (region 148/113 and 163/129 edge px over 2/4 px, against 82/50 at 0.3). At knuckle_rise >= 1.25 (range -0.5..1.5) it floats free as a separate shell. head_back 2.0 with phalanx_base 0.5, both in range, detaches the whole index finger. The build still succeeds and writes a GLB that fails A1. CONTRACTS s5 presents SHAPE_RANGES as the allowed range; neither doc nor code warns about this. Step 2 relies on this control for the left hand's largest residual, and D19 was chosen to avoid a second builder cycle. Fixable in this stage: in a scratch builder I anchored the knuckle's base and stretched it (centre lift 0.5 + rise/2, dorsal half-axis + rise/2 x N_head). At rise 0.3 this gives the same silhouette (IoU 0.96180 / mean 1.718 against 0.96178 / 1.717; region 82 over 2 px) with a smooth dome, it stays attached at 0.8, and it is identical to today's shape at rise 0, so the committed assets stay byte-identical. Also narrow the ranges (knuckle_rise to about <= 0.6, and bound head_back together with phalanx_base) or fail the build when shells > 1.
